name: Strawberry Shack
notes: Restaurant's own site (thestrawberryshack.com/?page_id=20) lists 33 item names but prices only 3 of them (Vybes Strawberry Lavender Hemp CBD $6.75, Chocolate Dipped Strawberry Fudge $6.00, Strawberry Dole Soft Serve $5.50 - checked individual item pages too, genuinely unpriced elsewhere on the site). Captured the 12 unique priced items from order.online (DoorDash white-label; DoorDash's own marketplace page for the same store returned byte-identical prices, confirming same backend, not an independent second source). DoorDash's menuCategories field lists only two categories (Most Ordered, Featured Items; 22 raw items, 12 unique after dedup) with no other categories in the payload, so this is the full delivery catalog, not a rendering artifact - but it does not cover all 33 named items on the restaurant's own site (likely items excluded because they don't survive delivery, e.g. fresh dipped strawberries, soft serve). Markup divisor test (1.04-1.25) found no consistent pattern (worst case 3/12=25% at div 1.2, within organic noise). No overlap between the restaurant's 3 own-site priced items and DoorDash's 12 items, so no direct cross-check was possible.

name: Encinitas Ale House
notes: Restaurant's own site is Wix (encinitasalehouse.com/menus). Wix only server-renders the active tab (BOTTLES), but the page's embedded populatedMenus JSON holds all 3 menus (FOOD 36 items, WINE LIST 63, BOTTLES 212) - however every item in that Wix data carries priceInfo $0.00 except one dessert with size variants, i.e. the Wix Menus app was populated with items but never given real prices (oloMigration* fields suggest it was imported from Olo and prices were not carried over or are managed elsewhere). Found the restaurant's live Toast ordering system instead: window.__OO_STATE__ on order.toasttab.com/online/encinitas-ale-house-1044-s-coast-hwy-101 holds the full 'EAH Food Menu' with real prices across 11 groups (To Start, Munchies, Baskets, Salads, Soup, Sandwich, Burgers, House Made Za's, Ale House Specialties, Daily Specials [empty], Desserts) - 50 priced dishes. Item names match the Wix FOOD catalog closely (e.g. Blackened Flat Iron Steak, Ahi & Avocado Poke Tower), confirming Toast is the current/live version of the same catalog with real pricing. Address (1044 S Coast Hwy 101, Encinitas) matches work list. Markup divisor test (1.04-1.25) found no consistent pattern (worst case 5/50=10% at 1.2), prices show normal POS .95/.00/.50 endings, not delivery-app markup. Drinks (beer bottles, wine list) have no priced source anywhere found - Wix lists 212 bottles and 63 wines by name with zero prices, and no separate priced beer/wine menu was located; food is fully captured, drinks are not.
